svg.aria-label: Measured results so far: speed flat from 1K to 12M tokens of history (pilot, not claimable; n=40 per cell); decode speed 74 to 167 tok/s (n=900 per arm); entity identity AUROC about 0.78 versus about 0.5 control (n=400 pairs per cell, diagnostic only).
